verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Neginah, [A Psalm] of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David.

verses.ar: اِسْمَعْ يَا ٱللهُ صُرَاخِي، وَٱصْغَ إِلَى صَلَاتِي.
verses.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.kjv: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.web: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

verses.he: מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ ׀ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּעֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑י בְּצוּר־יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: مِنْ أَقْصَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَدْعُوكَ إِذَا غُشِيَ عَلَى قَلْبِي. إِلَى صَخْرَةٍ أَرْفَعَ مِنِّي تَهْدِينِي.
verses.en: From the end of the earth will I call unto Thee, when my heart fainteth; lead me to a rock that is too high for me.
verses.kjv: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock [that] is higher than I.
verses.web: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.he: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל־עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אֹויֵֽב׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ كُنْتَ مَلْجَأً لِي، بُرْجَ قُوَّةٍ مِنْ وَجْهِ ٱلْعَدُوِّ.
verses.en: For Thou hast been a refuge for me, a tower of strength in the face of the enemy.
verses.kjv: For thou hast been a shelter for me, [and] a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.web: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.he: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אָהָלְךָ עֹולָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.ar: لَأَسْكُنَنَّ فِي مَسْكَنِكَ إِلَى ٱلدُّهُورِ. أَحْتَمِي بِسِتْرِ جَنَاحَيْكَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: I will dwell in Thy Tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of Thy wings. Selah
verses.kjv: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.web: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ يَا ٱللهُ ٱسْتَمَعْتَ نُذُورِي. أَعْطَيْتَ مِيرَاثَ خَائِفِي ٱسْمِكَ.
verses.en: For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows; Thou hast granted the heritage of those that fear Thy name.
verses.kjv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given [me] the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.web: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

verses.he: יָמִ֣ים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶ֣לֶךְ תֹּוסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נֹותָ֗יו כְּמֹו־דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.ar: إِلَى أَيَّامِ ٱلْمَلِكِ تُضِيفُ أَيَّامًا. سِنِينُهُ كَدَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ.
verses.en: Mayest Thou add days unto the king's days! May his years be as many generations!
verses.kjv: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: [and] his years as many generations.
verses.web: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

verses.he: יֵשֵׁ֣ב עֹ֭ולָם לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.ar: يَجْلِسُ قُدَّامَ ٱللهِ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. ٱجْعَلْ رَحْمَةً وَحَقًّا يَحْفَظَانِهِ.
verses.en: May he be enthroned before God for ever! Appoint mercy and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.kjv: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, [which] may preserve him.
verses.web: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

verses.he: כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לָעַ֑ד לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְדָרַ֗י יֹ֣ום ׀ יֹֽום׃
verses.ar: هَكَذَا أُرَنِّمُ لِٱسْمِكَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، لِوَفَاءِ نُذُورِي يَوْمًا فَيَوْمًا.
verses.en: So will I sing praise unto Thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.kjv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.web: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
